title: Tim Phillips confirms Borland's two drawings were classified under a security classification guide

tellings.quote: >> and Tim Phillips acknowledged yes Dylan drew two drawings and yes Arrow was told what to classify because of his security classification guide.

plain: A former Air Force intelligence specialist named Dylan Borland, who came forward about UFOs, says that Tim Phillips, a senior official at AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UFO reports, admitted that Borland had made two drawings of what he saw and that AARO was told to classify them because of a security classification guide, an official rulebook of what must be kept secret. Borland relays this as Phillips told it, with AARO's first director Sean Kirkpatrick also named. If true, it would mean the office meant to investigate was itself hiding material on orders.
